snippet.title: War Fantasy Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
WAR FANTASY is a psychological mindfuck FPS about the merging of war video games and real war.

The twisted offspring of Spec Ops: The Line and The Stanley Parable. An infinitely looping Black Mirror episode with no escape.

This game will not pull punches or ignore the tragic cost of conflict. Player actions have consequences. 

This is not a power fantasy. There is no heroism here. The boundary between simulation and reality is collapsing. There is only the next instruction.

Wishlist Here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4657920/War_Fantasy
